Door knocking
Maya hears a noise during her phone call
Door knocks
Door knocks again

MAYA hits or presses a swtich and makes a loud noise
Ryan reaches into car and Rudy startles him with a bang sound
Scarecrow watches MAYA taken a shower as she moves her head, he appears with sound getting louder and more intense the more the scene continues.
MAYA hears a strange sound and turns around
MAYA drops her phone and soon as she looks up DOLLFACE OR PINUP Appears staring at her - LOUD SOUND

scarecrow smashes his AXE through the door Maya is trying to lock.
Ryan carefully proceeds towards door Scarecrow smashes his Axe through the door. Maya screams
Maya and Ryan head towards Motorbike and it blows up

PIN UP or DOLL FACE can be seen in the back ground when Maya and Ryan provide light in the dark room.
Ryan and Maya hear a sound

Ryans shoots at Scarecrow with the shotgun not in shot of camera
Ryan fires shotgun
Maya makes a call and a brick is thrown at her car window
Scarecrow slams his axe on the car Ryan is in
Pin Up or Doll Face appears in shot with sound
Scarecrow rams the car with his truck
Maya discovers Jeffs decaying body whilst trying to get signal from phone.
DOLLFACE or PINUP appears behind Maya with loud music
DOLLFACE or PIN UP KNOCKS MAYA OUT
PIN UP or DOLL FACE SCREAMS AND CHANTS when turning around with Ryan holding a shotgun
Scarecrow runs up beside Ryan and knocks him out
PIN UP Stabs Ryan
After films finishes a small scene is shown Maya in Hospital bed and Scarecrow lying beside her. He looks at her whilst she raises her head/body
